title: Precision Eval Harness for Cost-Driven Batching/Caching and Safe Rollbacks
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Design and implement an evaluation harness that detects subtle quality regressions introduced by automated batching/caching recommendations and enables safe config apply/rollback. Focus is on precise, statistically-sound checks using multi-metric thresholds (semantic similarity, token-level divergence, end-to-end task accuracy) and a human-auditable golden corpus pipeline. The harness must integrate with the autotuner to gate recommendations, emit structured pass/fail signals for the rollout system, and provide a lightweight signal for fast canaries vs deeper nightly analyses.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs automatically against canary and production shadow traffic within the CI/CD pipeline and produces a pass/fail verdict
Golden corpus is versioned and immutable; compute produces semantic stability score and delta against baseline
Threshold strategy supports per-model, per-route profiles and historical rolling baseline (7/30/90 day)
Rollback triggers defined (statistical significance on primary metric OR any severe drop on high-priority prompts)
Dashboard and alerting (SLO breach + quality-regression) wired to Console and PagerDuty playbook
